title: 30-Day Chops
description: Learn to explode creatively around the drums. 30-Day Chops will teach you the fundamentals of drum chops through consistent daily practice. By the end of the month, you'll have a new arsenal of chops to help you explode in 1, 2, and 4 bar patterns anytime the song calls for it.

title: 30-Day Drummer
description: 30-Day Drummer: Season 3 is the next evolution on learning how to play drums – where you learn by actually playing the drums. By focusing on timing & coordination, you’ll build your skills over thirty days following daily guided workouts with your instructor, Domino Santantonio.

title: New Piano Players Start Here
description: Learning to play the piano is a lot of fun when you get to practice with Lisa on a day-to-day basis. In the next few weeks, you will gain the skills you need to play songs like a pro. You'll go step-by-step, building on skills that you learn as you work through each day. This will be a lot of fun, so let's jump right in!

title: Easy Chords
description: Welcome to Easy Chords! Join Lisa and get excited about unlocking the magic of inversions. Inversion will take your from playing basic chords to making them sound amazing.

title: 10-Day Fills
description: Welcome to 10-Day Fills! In this 10-day challenge, Domino will show you four easy drum fills that you can start playing right now. By the end of the series, you will be playing all of these fills, along with a full song!

title: Blues Essentials
description: Let's start off with a few ground rules and learn some theory so that we can get a jump-start with this course and learn some of the basics that Kevin will be covering over the next 30 days.
